entries.name: Fast lexical code search
entries.best_use: Large repositories where fast literal/regex search is central.

entries.name: Cross-reference code search
entries.supported_claim: Text search plus source navigation and history integrations.
entries.best_use: Self-hosted search with browsing across many repositories.
entries.important_boundary: Semantic/vector retrieval is outside its core.

entries.name: Structural parsing
entries.supported_claim: Concrete syntax trees and incremental parsing.
entries.best_use: Create symbol-aware chunks across supported grammars.
entries.important_boundary: Parsing alone provides no ranking or cross-file semantics.

entries.name: Code intelligence index
entries.supported_claim: Language-agnostic protocol for symbols and occurrences.
entries.best_use: Add definition/reference relationships produced by indexers.

entries.name: Embedding/vector store
entries.best_use: Store and retrieve code/document embeddings with metadata.
entries.important_boundary: Chunk quality and embedding relevance remain external.

entries.name: RAG orchestration
entries.supported_claim: Document ingestion, node parsing, retrieval, and evaluation components.
entries.important_boundary: Defaults are not a code-search benchmark.

entries.name: Code-aware assistant stack
entries.supported_claim: Open-source coding assistant with indexing/context-provider components.
entries.important_boundary: Product behavior couples several retrieval decisions.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
